findings.summary: The integrated-battery summary omitted the distinction from a user-replaceable cell.
evidence: The previous summary only said that the battery pack was integrated.

findings.summary: The packaging term was an awkward literal translation.
evidence: The previous note used the less natural term ‘omslag’.
findings.resolution: Changed to the clearer Norwegian term ‘innpakning’.

findings.summary: Low-drain was translated as low load, changing the battery capability warning.
evidence: The previous warning said ‘lav belastning’ rather than low discharge capability.
findings.resolution: Changed to ‘lav utladningskapasitet’ and retained the vaping warning.
